manaNeeded: {8}{U}{B}{R}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Cast Nekusar from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{B}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
Whenever your opponent draw a card during their draw step, Nekusar causes them to draw an additional card and triggers twice.
Resolve the first Nekusar trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining opponent.
